title: Near vs TAO - Which One Sux More?
description:
A viewer told me NEAR is truly AI and TAO isn't. So I dug into both to find out which one is actually AI.

NEAR is a layer 1 blockchain that AI agents run on. It started as NEAR.ai in 2017, co-founder Illia Polosukhin co-wrote "Attention Is All You Need", the Transformer paper behind ChatGPT, and today it runs NEAR AI Cloud and NEAR Intents. Bittensor is a network that produces AI: 128 subnets, each one a competition that produces an AI commodity like compute, inference and model training.

Then the part that matters for holders. NEAR's supply vote to cut new issuance from 2.5% to 1.6%, decided by about 0.4% of all NEAR, the new Bitwise NEAR ETF, and how a supply with no hard cap compares to $TAO's 21 million cap and halvings. Plus the three questions I use to judge any AI coin.
